summary: @servicetitan/dte-pdf-editor preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle shipped at the tarball root. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (`WV8StW` rotator, mixed literal/number array `n7gIxM`, hex-scrambled identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`, `bc3Kak`) and its filename does not correspond to any functionality of a React PDF editor. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped in the tarball root but are not declared in package.json `files` (which lists only `dist` and `src`), so the loader and payload were added outside the package's normal publish flow. The alternate-runtime delivery — fetching Bun specifically to execute an opaque bundle that Node-based scanners cannot introspect — combined with automatic execution via the preinstall lifecycle hook constitutes arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
